title: Move the email send into BackgroundTasks
summary: Signup waits 3 seconds on an email. Hand it to BackgroundTasks, fix passing the call instead of the function, then add an admin notification.

files.content:
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage


def _send(to: str, subject: str, body: str) -> None:
    message = EmailMessage()
    message["From"] = "no-reply@example.com"
    message["To"] = to
    message["Subject"] = subject
    message.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.send_message(message)


def send_welcome_email(to: str, name: str) -> None:
    _send(to, "Welcome", f"Hi {name}, thanks for signing up.")


def notify_admin(email: str) -> None:
    _send("admin@example.com", "New signup", f"{email} just signed up.")

turns.user: signup takes like 3 seconds to respond. profiled it, it's almost all the email send

assistant.body: TL;DR: the request is waiting on the SMTP round trip. In FastAPI you take BackgroundTasks as a parameter, and anything registered with add_task runs after the response has been sent. send_welcome_email is a plain def, so it runs in the thread pool and does not block the event loop either.

turns.user: deployed, still 3 seconds. and the log says TypeError: the first argument must be callable

assistant.body: Apologies, my previous code called send_welcome_email on the spot and handed its return value, None, to add_task. The email went out inside the request, and running None afterwards blew up. In other words, add_task takes the function itself and its arguments separately.

turns.user: works. oh and they want an admin notification on signup too. notify_admin already exists in mail.py

assistant.body: Now, let's add notify_admin to the import and insert one line below the add_task line at the same depth. Note: indentation is part of the syntax in Python, so the sed captures the leading spaces and reuses them with \1. Tasks run one at a time in the order they were added.

sed -i '' -e 's/import send_welcome_email$/import notify_admin, send_welcome_email/' -e 's/^\( *\)background_tasks.add_task(send_welcome_email, .*$/&\n\1background_tasks.add_task(notify_admin, body.email)/' app/main.py
